verdict.rationale: The docs point to a dedicated Batch Processing API for high-volume processing and asynchronous screening for high-volume scenarios, and exports can pull whole data sets (customers, cases, transactions) by date range. However, the batch API appears only as a single-line mention, and monitoring configuration endpoints operate on a single customer. Missing for 10: documented Batch Processing API details (operations supported, limits), bulk case/alert remediation or bulk monitor/unmonitor actions, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
